The '''Four-Hundred-Twenty-Fifth Special Infantry''', also known as the '''Dantooine Initiative''', was a [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] [[Infantry|unit]] that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Lenora Trazen]] during their [[Third Galactic War|third war]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
